structured_output.what_is_happening: A "merci" token on PumpSwap, launched through a Meteora virtual curve per GMGN and migrated at creation, was about 11 minutes old at detection. It went up about 350-410% in 11 minutes on $255k volume, with 1,830 unique buyers against only 89 sellers. It is one of more than 10 same-name "merci" tokens launched within about 15 minutes. Its own description field links to the Solscan page of another token (9NPm...pump). That token is the earliest (about 11 minutes older), the largest ($359k market cap, $597k h1 volume) and the likely canonical one. This coin looks like a copycat riding a live merci meta.

narrative.description: The 'merci' meme or cult (X account mercicult, site merciszn.fun) is spawning a wave of same-name launches. This suggests a real, fast-moving meta, probably a viral phrase or post.
narrative.why_spreading: More than 10 copies in about 15 minutes and $600k/h of volume on the leader show strong short-term attention to the name. This coin captures overflow from that.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, and the links appear copied. The metadata description points to the pump.fun token 9NPm...pump, which implies this is a derivative and not the original. It is currently the #2 merci by market cap and liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 9NPmnDgL...pump ($359k market cap, $55k liquidity, $597k h1 volume, earliest) is the likely canonical token. Several other copies have already been drained to about $1 liquidity. 3jRq... is at $93k and 3JJm... at $72k.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer count is broad (1,830 unique buyers). But the 1,830 buyers versus 89 sellers split is extreme and fits bot or bundled buying. GMGN flags 38 bundler wallets and a 39-wallet insider trade network. The bot/degen rate is 10.8% and there are no smart-money or KOL wallets. The dev holds 1.77% and this is their first launch. Many sibling copies with $1 liquidity show that a serial copy-and-rug pattern is active on this name.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see whether the 80% top holder is a pool vault; GMGN's 9.5% top-10 figure suggests it is. I also can't verify the X links.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.98% of LP as unlocked on one market (GMGN reports lp_burn_ratio 1.0, which conflicts)
An unlabeled wallet holds 80% (likely a pool, but not confirmed)
38 bundler wallets and a 39-wallet insider network
Copycat of the canonical token, and siblings are already rugged to $1 liquidity
$27k liquidity against a $232k market cap; the price was already +350% before entry

structured_output.counterargument: The merci meta is clearly hot. Secondary copies sometimes run when the leader pumps because traders rotate into the 'cheaper' copy. This coin is the clear #2 with real liquidity, the most breadth of any copy (1,830 buyers), and a 5-minute buy rate far above its hourly rate. If the leader pushes past $1M market cap, a 2x from about $230k is plausible.
unknowns: Whether the 80% holder is the pool or a whale
The real LP lock status (RugCheck and GMGN disagree)
What the merci meme is and how durable it is
Whether the canonical token keeps pumping
The entry price after a volatile 5-minute window (-12% to +28%)

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical copycat in a hot same-name wave. It has bundler and insider flags and a possible unlocked LP, and it had already gone up 4x before entry. Copycats usually bleed or get pulled once attention settles on the original, so the odds of +100% before -50% are below the pool average.
